## Topics
- Writing a reproducible analysis report in Quarto
- Tables (gtsummary) and figure captions
- Project organization and package versions (renv)
- Final project presentations

## Learning objectives
By the end of this week you should be able to:

- Produce a polished, fully reproducible Quarto report
- Make a Table 1 with gtsummary
- Organize a project so someone else can rerun it
